source.source_locator: 教則 第5章 5.2.1(2)2)「離陸方法」（教則表示ページ57 / PDF viewer 63）

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: ヘリコプターは十分なローター回転数を得てから離陸する。
evidence.tested_misconception: 低回転のまま離陸しても空中で補えば安全性は同じ。
evidence.reasoning_path: rotor speed -> control response -> wait before liftoff

collision.note: LOW。現行canonicalにヘリコプター離陸時のローター回転数要件は未出。

independent_review.rationale: 5.2.1 requires sufficient rotor speed before helicopter liftoff because low rotor speed can delay aircraft response. No canonical item tests this takeoff sequencing requirement.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent with the current MLIT 第5版 Chapter 5, preserves second-class scope, and correctly isolates one semantic duplicate. The other 19 candidates test distinct operational process, insurance/security, GNSS-off control, aircraft-specific takeoff/landing technique, human-error mitigation, CRM-skill, and assistant-role propositions with useful practice value.
